retrieve_return_folder.title: Retrieve return folder
retrieve_return_folder.caption: At the east-wall file cabinet closest to the mail cubby, open the middle drawer. Lift the front hanging folder clear of the rails, hang it back in front of the second folder, then close the drawer with both folders inside. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

raise_connected_desk.title: Raise connected desk
raise_connected_desk.caption: Find the height-adjustable desk in the separate office with two chairs facing it. Press its up control to raise the desktop to standing height. Keep the cables connected, then use the down control to return it to its original sitting height and release the button. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

open_copier_access.title: Open copier access
open_copier_access.caption: Find the large printer against the back wall between the supply cabinet and the bookcases. On the printer’s left side, move the release lever to retract the latch and swing the jam-access cover fully open. Close the cover, then return the lever to its starting position. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

access_supply_cupboard.title: Open and close the cupboard
access_supply_cupboard.caption: Face the two-door supply cabinet on the back wall to the left of the printer. Open the left door first, then the right, until the stocked shelves are exposed. Close the right door, then the left, and leave both shut. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

open_staple_magazine.title: Open staple magazine
open_staple_magazine.caption: Hold the base of the stapler on the work table, beside the hole punch. Lift its head and slide the staple magazine out to expose the loading channel. Slide the magazine fully back in, then lower and release the head. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

distribute_mail_folder.title: Distribute mail folder
distribute_mail_folder.caption: Face the mail cubby beside the row of file cabinets. Take the loose manila folder from the left column, third shelf from the bottom. Lay it on the clear front-right part of the work table, directly in front of the binding machine, and release it. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

cycle_hole_punch.title: Cycle hole punch
cycle_hole_punch.caption: Steady the hole punch on the work table between the stapler and the binding machine. Slide its paper guide to the left stop, then press the handle until the pins descend. Release the handle so the pins rise and return the guide to its starting position. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

reset_binding_comb.title: Reset the binding machine
reset_binding_comb.caption: Hold the binding machine steady at the right end of the work table. Slide the paper-edge guide to the left stop, then move the side lever until the comb rack and fingers open. Return the lever to close the rack and fingers, then reset the guide. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.
